title: Partial Noclip And Vehicle Speed Changer READ DESCRIPTION
features:
This script is made by me and a bit complicated from time to time

How to use it: If you want to use this script you need to spawn a car and get inside the driver seat and then execute it, if you dont do this the car will just bug out and you will need to rejoin the game.

Also if you for some reason respawn or reset after youve executed this script you need to rejoin aswell if you want to spawn a car.

NOTE:
This is a partial Noclip script so if you want to use this you can Noclip from spawn to the border but after the border the roads are funky and you will drive under the roads / on the terrain. However to combat this the speed script inside this Script has a car fly feature so you can just fly or just push people around, troll etc.

Enjoy!
